comment: The knobs are not in panel order: left to right the panel reads X, Y, W, R, A, which is parameter index 0, 1, 3, 4, 2. Parameter 2 is the angle switch at the right-hand end and parameter 3 is the width knob in the middle. The module's own right-click menu holds nothing but the theme choices, so it has no line here; everything else is on the hamburger at the end of the template row.
